variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by a union in the colony.
variants.body:
A union has called a strike in {colony}. The call establishes a labour action, not an account of its participation or outcome. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the decision to call a strike from unreported claims about wages, conditions or the response of an employer.

Our movement believes a political principle should have something to say about the people who do the work. Collective action deserves serious judgment, including an examination of purpose and responsibility. Neither an instinctive cheer nor an instinctive denunciation is an adequate substitute for a principled position on labour relations.

We criticise {target} in this dispute. Labour relations call for a responsible standard, and a strike call is an appropriate moment to question whether the interests at stake have been handled adequately. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.

variants.sub: The colony has a union call for strike action.
variants.body:
